description: Utility class for processing lists of Note objects into categorized, time-based, or initial-based grouped lists with section headers for an Android notes application.

classes.name: SlotterUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to generate lists of items with section headers based on category, time, or initials for a notes app.

methods.name: fillListByCategory
methods.description: Creates a list of items grouped by category, inserting section items for category headers.

methods.name: fillListByTime
methods.description: Creates a list of items grouped by timeslot, inserting section items for timeslot headers.

methods.name: fillListByInitials
methods.description: Creates a list of items grouped by the initial letter of their titles, inserting section items for each initial.
